title: In Gaza, after 20 years without elections, an uncertain vote
subhead: Caught between impatience for political renewal and profound mistrust of Hamas, which they hold responsible for provoking the devastating Israeli war with the October 7 massacres, Gazans struggle to imagine holding an election in a ravaged territory that remains deeply insecure.

title: French scientist Henri Kagan wins long-awaited Nobel Prize in Chemistry
subhead: The researcher received the award on Wednesday, alongside Japanese chemist Kenso Soai. They were honored for their groundbreaking work on asymmetric catalysis.

title: In Somalia, war cuts off aid for entire populations threatened by famine
subhead: Violent clashes between rival government factions have further worsened the food crisis affecting nearly seven million Somalis.
